verdict.rationale: Gemini in Firebase is a built-in natural-language chat assistant in the Firebase console. It answers product questions, generates code, explains Crashlytics crashes with root causes and fixes, and summarizes and analyzes messaging campaigns. These are mostly advisory and analytical outputs, not documented delegation of tasks the assistant carries out in the project. The MCP server serves external editors, not an in-product assistant, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented agentic task execution inside the console (e.g., the assistant creating or modifying resources on the user's behalf), independent or hands-on corroboration of the assistant's delegation depth.
